notes: Installed Carmen T1 for full 5 before the free R&D run that would have discounted it, then sat at 0 credits for six turns spamming 4-5 R&D runs per turn (T1-T6) that re-accessed the same top card. With the Runner at 6 points it installed Sericulture Expansion in a new remote behind a single Diviner (T12), which was immediately stolen for the loss.

Facechecked HQ T1 with 1 credit, and repeatedly ran HQ into the known Paywall without the 2 credits to pass (T11, T14, T15). Never found a way into Server 1, so at 6 points it spent T16-T18 on economy and Archives/HQ while Remastered Edition was installed and scored for the loss (T18-T19).

Clicked for credits four times a turn from T5-T8 and T11-T16 while sitting on 20-46 credits and a full grip, with no pressure on R&D or HQ. Left R&D bare T1 (Regenesis stolen), then played Neurospike T3 with no agenda scored, throwing away 3 credits that left it broke for the rest of the game, and after Chastushka it never iced Archives where Hybrid Release and See How They Run were taken. From T6 it hovered at 0-3 credits and could not advance Hybrid Release in Server 3 before the Runner got through Hafrun T11.

Spent T1 icing and advancing a remote while leaving R&D and HQ bare, and the Runner took 4 points from R&D on T1. After that it scored Lotus Haze, Longevity Serum and Regenesis sensibly from a growing remote, but its economy stayed thin, so the R&D ice never got rezzed and Longevity Serum was stolen from R&D T12.

Leaving HQ unprotected T1 let Chastushka gut the hand, and it then sat at 0-4 credits T4-T10 with both R&D ice unrezzed, so the Runner walked in for Hybrid Release (T6) and See How They Run plus Lotus Haze (T9). Scoring from iced remotes (Longevity Serum T2, Regenesis T9, Sisyphus T13, See How They Run T16) and Bladderwort drip were sensible.

Early facecheck into Grubber on HQ T1 cost a turn of credits, but it then punished the weakly iced Server 1 for Kingmaking, Remastered Edition and Oracle Thinktank on T2-T4. Built Nanuq and economy and closed by breaking through four ice on Server 1 then R&D T11, with only the 5-credit IP Enforcement trash (T8) being questionable.

A clean, short game: it iced centrals and played Hedge Fund T1, then on T2 baited with an advanced Lotus Haze behind Saisentan, and Saisentan's net damage plus the Personal Evolution ID damage on the steal flatlined the Runner.
